title: Signal: PHP error with a source path disclosed
scope: Single response body: confirm no PHP notice, warning, or fatal error with a file and line is returned.
limitations: Pattern on one body: a PHP message quoted in a bug report can match.

observation.body: Warning: Undefined variable $cart in /var/www/html/shop.php on line 14

fpNotes: Quoted messages in documentation are the common false positive.
